pro_l01.text: Rain taps on the attic window.

provenance.asrText: Rain taps on the attic window.

pro_l02.text: Grandpa, your old compass is under the chess box!
pro_l02.zh: 爷爷，你的旧罗盘在象棋盒下面！

provenance.asrText: Grandpa, your old compass is under the chess box.
That is my compass, Leo.

pro_l04.text: Why does the needle not move?

provenance.asrText: Why does the needle not move?

pro_l05.text: Seventeen empty star slots form a ring.
pro_l05.zh: 十七个空星槽围成一圈。

provenance.asrText: 17 empty star slots form a ring.

pro_l06.text: Each slot waits for a star.
pro_l06.zh: 每个星槽都在等一颗星。

provenance.asrText: Each slot waits for a star.

pro_l07.text: The compass feels warm in my hand!

provenance.asrText: The compass feels warm in my hand.

pro_l08.text: Biscuit runs past with a sock.
pro_l08.zh: Biscuit 叼着一只袜子跑过去。

provenance.asrText: Biscuit runs past with a sock.
Look after it, Leo.

pro_l10.text: I am ready for our first adventure!
pro_l10.zh: 我准备好开始第一次冒险啦！

provenance.asrText: I am ready for our first adventure!

char_leo.text: I love adventures, and so does Grandpa.

char_mia.text: Can I ask one more question?

provenance.asrText: Can I ask one more question?

char_sam.text: I am the fastest runner in our crew!
char_sam.zh: 我是队里跑得最快的人！

char_lily.text: Wait. Let me read the rules first.

char_biscuit.text: Biscuit finds an old striped sock.
char_biscuit.zh: Biscuit 找到一只旧条纹袜子。

char_grandpa.text: When I was your age, I loved chess.
char_grandpa.zh: 我像你这么大时，很喜欢下棋。

provenance.asrText: When I was your age, I loved chess.

char_viking_captain.text: Bring an axe, a shield and the captain's helmet!
char_viking_captain.zh: 拿一把斧头、一面盾牌，还有船长的那顶头盔！

provenance.asrText: Bring an axe, a shield, and the captain's helmet.

char_dragon.text: He guards books, so he stays in and reads on Mondays.
char_dragon.zh: 他守护书籍，所以星期一他待在洞里看书。

provenance.asrText: Bob cooks breakfast every morning.

char_tina.text: Tina always washes the cups after breakfast.
char_tina.zh: Tina 早餐后总会洗杯子。

provenance.asrText: Tina always washes the cups after breakfast.

char_zed.text: Zed does not clean the streets, but he paints pictures for the town.
char_zed.zh: Zed 不打扫街道，但他给小镇画画。

provenance.asrText: Zed does not clean the streets, but he paints pictures for the town.

char_olympia_officer.text: The race starts at three o'clock on the fifth day.
char_olympia_officer.zh: 比赛在第五天下午三点开始。

provenance.asrText: The race starts at three o'clock on the fifth day.

char_dad.text: Dad tastes a tiny rock, and it tastes delicious.
char_dad.zh: 爸爸尝了一小块石头，味道真好。

char_mars_commander.text: The commander says Leo should practise in the simulator first.
char_mars_commander.zh: 指挥官说 Leo 应该先在模拟器里练习。

provenance.asrText: The commander says Leo should practice in the simulator first.

char_cheetah.text: The cheetah runs more quickly than Sam.
char_cheetah.zh: 猎豹跑得比 Sam 更快。

char_elephant.text: The elephant is the strongest of the three animals.
char_elephant.zh: 大象是这三只动物里最强壮的。

provenance.asrText: The elephant is the strongest of the three animals.

char_mermaid_mayor.text: The mermaid mayor lets everyone enter the city.
char_mermaid_mayor.zh: 人鱼市长让大家进入城市。

char_redbeard.text: Redbeard said that he would guide them to the island.
char_redbeard.zh: 红胡子船长说过，他会带他们去那座岛。

provenance.asrText: Redbeard said that he would guide them to the island.

char_moon_robot.text: The old robot has lived here for fifty years.
char_moon_robot.zh: 老机器人已经在这里生活了五十年。

provenance.asrText: The old robot has lived here for 50 years.

char_museum_guard.text: By the time the guard opened the door, the crown had disappeared.
char_museum_guard.zh: 等守卫打开门时，皇冠已经不见了。

char_clockwork_mouse.text: A clockwork mouse was caught beside the crown and its cosy sock nest.
char_clockwork_mouse.zh: 一只发条老鼠在皇冠和它舒适的袜子窝旁被抓住了。

char_grumble.text: Welcome! I need a helper to guard my socks.
char_grumble.zh: 欢迎！我需要一个帮手来看守我的袜子。

char_mum.text: Here are Mum and Dad, ready to join the adventure.
char_mum.zh: 妈妈和爸爸也来了，准备加入冒险。
